Pleasanton_FY2025 categorised the identical line as charges for services/fees, so the two reports are inconsistent. Kept as a warning because the page doesn't break it down.

issues.on_page: Internal Service Fund (Fire) column: Local Receipts: Other 82,378.77; Public Safety - Police & Fire 47,590.08
issues.issue: An internal service fund is technically a proprietary fund (the rules list proprietary under business-type). Treating it as governmental is defensible because it works as a fire fund (public safety spending), but it is an assumption. It also puts 82,378.77 (33% of governmental receipts) in 'other' with nothing explaining it (possibly rural fire contract payments).
